rules: Original industrial results remain unchanged; Earth launch flow is conditional on architecture.
All chemical Earth-return braking is propulsive; no aerocapture, free braking or propellant at LEO without delivery.

Electric efficiency is from stored water and electrical bus to exhaust kinetic energy, including feed processing and all gas use; current oxygen-anode specific impulse is not a demonstrated total-water specific impulse.
All new fleet modules are Earth-manufactured in this comparison; the earlier source-structure localization case remains independent.

Additional route inventories are filled from the source network and enter construction material flows; a 2 percent first-dispatch Earth-fuel seed is an explicit bootstrap allowance, not continuing Earth propellant procurement.
Quarter-year depot inventories, 25 percent installed spare margin and 80 percent fleet availability are separate allowances.
Core city/town geometry, population, source protections and ordinary material demand remain fixed.
